verdicts.reason: A keeps the cream disc behind the bottle and has a clear stack: product, headline, subcopy, then actions. The flaws are a centred product above left-aligned text, a NEW pill nearly as heavy as the CTA so the two compete, and generous dead space at the top. B breaks the illustration: the cream disc has come loose and sits cut off in the bottom-left corner, crowding the NEW pill. That leaves the bottle as a faint orange-on-orange outline that almost disappears, so the key product image is lost.
